component.name: Lightloom
component.summary: Control the RGB lighting of your PC

description.p: Lightloom is an open-source RGB lighting manager. One daemon drives keyboards, mice, headsets, RAM, graphics cards, motherboards, fans and LED strips from many vendors, and a dashboard in your browser arranges them into a layout and plays effects across all of them.

ul.li: Device support comes from plugins: plain JavaScript files you can read and edit
Canvas effects written as web pages, plus audio- and screen-reactive effects
A local API and CLI for scripting; nothing leaves your computer
Runs as your user, never as root

description.p: One-time host setup is required for device access: udev rules, and for RAM and graphics card lighting the i2c group and the i2c-dev module. Run "flatpak run org.lightloom.Lightloom --setup-help" for the commands.
First public pre-release: plugin host, effects, dashboard, profiles, per-LED colours, macros. Not yet tested on Linux hardware.
